# Zahid Hasan Tonmoy

Zahid Hasan Tonmoy is a MERN Full Stack Developer, Data Analyst, AI Agent Developer, and Digital Marketer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He builds end-to-end web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js. He specialises in transforming complex data into actionable insights, building intelligent AI solutions, and crafting effective digital strategies.

## Services & Skills
- **Web Development**: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Supabase.
- **Data Analysis**: Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow.
- **AI Agent Development**: Machine Learning, NLP, Predictive Modeling.

## Key Projects
- **Flexpath**: A mobile-first gig economy platform for Bangladesh using Flutter and Supabase.
- **Gold Price Predictor**: A machine learning application predicting daily gold closing prices.
- **Curious Cart BD**: A full-stack e-commerce platform built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
- **LocalDrop Pro**: A peer-to-peer file sharing and real-time chat web application via WebRTC.
